capabilityHint: The counts cover only the records loaded here. A missing measurement does not mean that the device cannot measure it, that a sensor is disconnected or that something is faulty.
latestHint: If any record of a measurement has no confirmed UTC time, the times for that measurement are shown as unknown. A record can include the measurement with an empty value, so the last value can be earlier than the last record.
seriesHint: The line simply joins the loaded values. The values in between were not measured, and the line is not smoothed. Empty or missing values break the line.
breakBefore: The line also breaks at known data gaps and where records are more than
breakAfter: minutes apart. This limit is a display setting in holita, not how often the device sends data.
clockHint: The chart cannot be shown because not every loaded record has a confirmed UTC time. The original times are still in the table.
noNumeric: This measurement has no values in the loaded records.
orderUtc: Records are sorted by time (UTC). Records with the same time keep the order in which they were received.
orderSource: Records are shown in the order in which they were received, because not every record has a confirmed UTC time.
chooseRecord: Choose a record to see its value and its position on the map.
missingSelection: The selected record is not among the loaded records. Choose another row.
missingChannel: The selected measurement is not in the loaded data. Choose another measurement.
noChannels: There are no measurements in the loaded data.
emptyHint: Loading finished, but no records were found. This does not mean that a sensor or the vehicle has a problem.
unavailableHint: The measurements have not been loaded. Missing values are not counted as zero.
